## Overview

Build, in groups, an HTTP API with Javalin and deploy it to a cloud
virtual machine behind a reverse proxy, with a domain name and HTTPS.

Covers chapters: SSH & SCP · HTTP & curl · Web infrastructures · Caching &
performance.
